pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pAnalyses clean circuit boards, reveals stability, returns the analysed board and can award recipe-driven items or FE.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Clean or repair the raw chip first.$p2. Insert the unanalysed clean board.$p3. Leave room for the board and additional rewards.$p4. Read the returned board tooltip before fabrication or plug use.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAlready analysed boards do not run again. The analyser can also export generated/reward energy, subject to its sides.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
